meta.title: THEParents: Every Contributor Is a Parent
meta.description: A multilingual knowledge library and community publishing platform that supports education for disadvantaged children, starting in Vietnam.

footer.tagline: Share Knowledge. Create Opportunities. Change Lives.

home.heroSubtitle: Discover ideas, share knowledge, and help create educational opportunities for children who need them most.
home.latestEmpty: No articles have been published yet. Published articles will appear here.
home.step1Body: Browse articles in four languages, free for everyone.
home.step2Body: Create an account and publish your own article. Your first two are free.
home.step3Body: Later articles carry a small contribution that is meant to support children's education.
home.impactBody: THEParents aims to turn community participation into support for children who lack access to education, beginning in Vietnam and later across Asia.
home.impactNote: Impact reporting will begin when verified funding and distribution data become available.
home.publishBody: Every account can publish two articles for free. After that, publishing costs 2,000 VND per article, or you can choose a monthly membership. The monthly price has not been set yet. Payment never guarantees publication: every article is reviewed.

explore.intro: Search the library and filter by category or language.
explore.notConnected: The article library is not connected to a database yet. Add the Supabase settings described in the README.

article.missionNote: Reading and writing here supports education for children who need it.
